name: Aeryth
source:
Aeryth takes place in a deserted world thought to be lifeless. In this world Aeryth a girl known for her useless dreams lives in temple with a priest Po who always seems to be deep in their studies.

Today like any other she has a dream one that will lead her to a strange girl, and her own heart.

[from [url=https://yourcardisdeath.itch.io/aeryth]itch.io[/url]]
